title: Welcome to SBI Hub
description: SBI Hub brings small-business intelligence tools together in one place. The Financial Modeler and Business Valuation modules are available now; additional modules are in development.

title: Business Valuation Now Available
description: The Business Valuation & Succession module is live. It opens in a new tab as its own application, independent of the hub.

title: Financial Modeler Now Integrated
description: The full Operating Model financial modeling tool is live inside SBI Hub. Existing saved scenarios continue to work unchanged.

title: More Modules on the Way
description: Six additional modules — from feasibility to automation evaluation — are planned for upcoming builds.
